description: Guard (016 T014p, round-7 review F1, b09). A script start closes and reopens a script; CommonMark ends that block at the line, and a processing instruction block starts on the next line and runs past the blank line to its '?>'. The opener inside it is raw HTML, so the browser's comment hides the marker after it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. c565240 kept the reopened script open past the line where CommonMark ends its block, missed the block starting inside it, and on the close returned to inline text, so the opener was disarmed and the marker harvested.
